findings.claim: CacheImpl reads py_func.__qualname__ before constructing filename_base; get_filename_base includes the qualified name.
Source freshness is only the source file mtime and size; the index filename is based on filename_base.
The overload key hashes function bytecode and closure plus codegen.magic_tuple; a same-size/same-mtime comment or captured-helper edit is not represented.
Cached environment reconstruction imports the module and uses its globals and env_name; it does not resolve the Python function by qualified name.

FunctionDescriptor.lookup_function would use getattr(module, qualname), but no Python call sites exist in the installed Numba tree. Fresh-process warm-cache qualification remains required to cover native or unobserved paths.

assessment: No source-level serialization or location blocker was found. The decorator must remain below njit so it runs first; execution admission requires fresh-process warm cache loads.
